parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language in which you want the results to be displayed. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese. en: English.

parameters.name: DnsServerList
parameters.description: The list of Domain Name System (DNS) servers (for DNS domain name services only).

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

parameters.name: IpList
parameters.description: The address list of fixed address services or domain name list of Domain Name System (DNS) services.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The service name. This parameter is deprecated and cannot be modified. The value of this parameter must be the same as the current service name.

parameters.name: ServicePort
parameters.description: The service port. Specify this parameter for DNS services.

parameters.name: ServiceProtocol
parameters.description:
The service protocol.

- HTTP

- HTTPS

- HTTP2

- GRPC

- DUBBO

parameters.name: TlsSetting
parameters.description:
The Transport Layer Security (TLS) settings. Valid values:

- mode: TLS mode

- certId: certificate ID

- caCertId: CA certificate ID

- caCertContent: CA certificate public key

- sni: service name identification
